title: Help and safety
lead: If you're in danger or someone hurt you, you're not alone. These services are free and confidential.

sms.label: Emergencies by text, if you can't speak

report.title: Report outside the app
report.violence: Report sexual or gender-based violence to the police, online, 24/7

schools.title: At your school
schools.lead: Each school has a service against sexual and gender-based violence. You can contact them even if it happened off campus.
schools.epita: EPITA violence reporting platform (link on the intranet)
schools.esme: ESME reporting platform (link on the intranet)
schools.supbiotech: Sup'Biotech reporting platform (link on the intranet)
schools.isg: ISG Lyon officer for sexual and gender-based violence (contact the administration)
schools.verified: Links checked at the start of every academic year.

inApp.title: In Atomes
inApp.block: Block: immediate, mutual, the person isn't told.
inApp.report: Report: from a profile, a photo or a message. It's anonymous for the reported person.
inApp.hide: Hide specific people or your school, from settings.

install.title: Atomes on your home screen
install.lead: Full screen, one tap to open, and notifications. No store: the app installs from your browser in thirty seconds.
install.installed: Already done: you are using the installed app.
install.detected: Detected automatically, change it if needed.

share.title: Tap Share
share.body: The square with an arrow pointing up, at the bottom of Safari (top right in Chrome).

add.title: Add to Home Screen
add.body: Scroll through the options if needed, then tap “Add to Home Screen”.

confirm.title: Add
confirm.body: Tap “Add” at the top right: the Atomes icon lands on your home screen.

ios.note: On iPhone, notifications only work from the installed app (iOS 16.4 or later).

menu.title: Open the menu
menu.body: The three dots at the top right of Chrome.

install.title: Install app
install.body: Or “Add to home screen”, depending on your browser.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.body: Atomes joins your apps, like any other.

icon.title: Find the install icon
icon.body: On the right of the address bar in Chrome and Edge. In Safari (macOS), File menu, then “Add to Dock”.

install.title: Install
install.body: Confirm: Atomes opens in its own window, without tabs.

desktop.note: Firefox cannot install web apps yet: use Chrome, Edge or Safari.

banner.text: Install Atomes on your home screen: full screen and notifications.

helpLink.title: Install the app
helpLink.body: The step-by-step guide for iPhone, Android and computers.
